## When ARGUS suggests it

Your resting heart rate is at Watch or higher on your personal baseline and your body temperature is at Watch or higher, or rash is ticked in the symptom checklist.

## Steps

1. Rest. [demo wording]
2. Re-measure heart rate and temperature in 2 hours. [demo wording]
3. Hydrate. [demo wording]
4. Isolate shared items. [demo wording]
5. Log your symptoms. [demo wording]
6. Send a report to the flight surgeon. [demo wording]
